name: Tine

facts.text: Level 67, 50,000 health, spawned by Xaga; a flying spirit whose spell Tine's Fire deals 450 heat over a 450 radius.
For Living Server raids she holds low over the floor while fought so melee can reach her; otherwise she circles the room.

story:
Tine is the fire Xaga bound to her staff, a spirit of flame that circles the seed-keeper's room on the air. She was a hearth-fire once, the Sylvan say, the small fire a wanderer lights in a wet wood to stay alive, and Xaga kept her because nothing grows in the dark without a little warmth. Now she warms nothing. When her mistress is touched she drops from the air and bursts in a ring of heat, and she calls her sister Beatha to do the same. She will come down to fight; she will not come down to be caught.

Every Sylvan knows the small fire a wanderer lights in a wet wood to stay alive through the night. Tine was one of those once, the spirit of a hearth-fire on a cold hillside, and Xaga kept her because nothing grows in the dark without a little warmth. Xaga bound her to the staff with the old words and named her plainly: Tine, fire.

Bound, Tine warms nothing. She circles her mistress's room on the air with her sister Beatha, and when Xaga is touched she drops from the ceiling and bursts in a ring of heat that fills the room around her, and calls Beatha to do the same, and calls Xaga too. She will come down low enough for a warrior's blade; she will not be caught. The first Living Server realm raid to reach Xaga's room wiped on Tine, not on Xaga. The raiders who survived say she burned brighter every time one of them fell, as if the deaths fed her the way kindling feeds a fire. When she dies the Sylvan say a hillside somewhere on the isle gets a little colder, as a wanderer's fire goes out.
legend: Fire spirit with a big heat burst: spread out and keep heat resists up. She calls Beatha and Xaga, so be ready for all three. Melee can reach her while she is fought. The realm raid wiped on her not long ago; take her seriously. If the raid kills her first, everyone in heat resists and the healers keep a step back from her burst; if Beatha goes first, Tine's tank keeps her pinned in a corner away from the casters. Superstition: never light a pipe in Xaga's room. Tine notices. The raiders who laugh at that one usually laugh from the floor.

loremasterTopic.text: Xaga's fire, a hearth-flame turned to a weapon. She bursts in a ring of heat and calls her sister Beatha.

bookPage: From Aodhan's notes: the Sylvan have a word for the fire a lost traveller makes in a wet wood, and it is the same word as Tine. Such a fire, they say, is the bravest thing on the isle, a small light holding off a whole night. Xaga found one and bound it to her staff, and now it is a weapon, circling her room on the air and bursting in heat on those who come to free it. The fire-keeper said the realm's warriors should not hate Tine. She was brave once. Put her out gently, she said, if such a thing can be done gently. It cannot, I said. She said: then quickly.
